answer: Merge look-alike voters. Each epoch the network compares every pair of keys on how often their grades move together; keys that agree on over 90% of rows, like streams in one karst cave, are folded into a single vote and split one reward. A farm of 50 keys driven by one model collapses to the weight of one agent while still paying 50 entry bonds of 50 POA, so it loses money. Staying unmerged needs truly independent judgment, an onyx-hard cost per key; no opal shimmer of reworded output hides it.
